heroSummary: DeKalb County School District students start school on Friday, August 7, 2026, and finish on Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Fall break is October 12–13, Thanksgiving break is November 23–27, winter break is December 21 through January 1, and spring break is March 22–26. February 15 and April 26 are reserved as possible make-up days and may become student attendance days.

calendarNotes: DeKalb County School District students start the 2026–27 school year on Friday, August 7, 2026, and finish on Wednesday, May 26, 2027. The official calendar lists 177 instructional days and 10 employee work/PD days. February 15 and April 26 are possible make-up days, and April 27 is listed separately as a flex/PD day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does DeKalb County school start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Friday, August 7, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for DeKalb County in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. It is also the end of the fourth grading period.

calendarFaqs.q: When is DeKalb County Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for DeKalb County School District in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027. January 4–5 are PD days, and the third grading period begins January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fall Break for DeKalb County Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 12 through Tuesday, October 13, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the DeKalb 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official 2026–27 DeKalb calendar lists 177 instructional days and 10 employee work/PD days.

calendarFaqs.q: What are DeKalb make-up days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists February 15 and April 26, 2027 as possible make-up days. Either date may become a student attendance day if the district needs to make up instructional time lost to weather or another closure.

calendarFaqs.q: When are DeKalb PD days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists PD days on August 4–5, September 8, January 4–5, February 16, and May 27, plus a flex/PD day on April 27.

customSections.label: What DeKalb Families Should Know for 2026–27
customSections.content: Students begin school on Friday, August 7. September 8 is a professional development day, creating a four-day weekend for students. After winter break, students return on Wednesday, January 6 because January 4 and 5 are PD days. February 15 and April 26 are reserved as possible make-up days and may become student attendance days if the district needs to recover lost instructional time. April 27 is listed separately as a flex/PD day.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2025–26 Calendar
content: School starts three days later than it did in 2025–26.
The school year ends two days earlier.
The new calendar has 177 instructional days, three fewer than the previous year.
Spring break shifts from early April to late March (March 22–26, 2027).
